_about: Industry Partners hall in the Stellar Aviation FBO, the terminal of Solport (plan_terminal.js). Edit any line here without touching code. Talk nodes: t = what the character says, o = the reply buttons as [label, next node index or null to close]. contact = the selectable lines shown under the talk card. footer = a line always shown under the card for that character. hall.title: INDUSTRY PARTNERS
hall.subtitle: A coalition of established aviation, logistics, and investment partners ready to bring jobs, activity, and long-term investment to Douglas.

stellar.name: Stellar Aviation
stellar.blurb: A proven FBO operator, now running the FBO at Solport: fuel, hangar, ground services, a crew lounge and concierge, along with local jobs.

npc.name: Brad Kost
npc.role: Founding Partner and COO · Stellar Aviation

greet: Welcome to Solport. This is the Stellar Aviation FBO.
Fuel, hangar and ground services, all at one desk.
Flying in? We look after the aircraft, the crew and you.

talk.t: I'm Brad Kost, Founding Partner and COO of Stellar Aviation. Stellar operates the FBO here at Solport: this whole building is our FBO, and we look after every aircraft, crew and passenger that comes through it. What would you like to know?

An FBO, a fixed base operator, is the front door of an airfield for private aviation: fuel, ramp and overnight parking, hangar space, a crew lounge and flight planning room, concierge, rental cars and ground transport. When a jet lands here, we look after the aircraft, the crew and the passengers.

Right here. Stellar operates the FBO at Solport, so fuel, hangar space, ground services, the crew lounge and concierge all run through this desk, with fueling out on the ramp by Gate A2. Genesis One's own parcels never sell fuel: the hangar homes and the Flight Line stay fuel free.
Stellar runs FBOs at Reno (KRNO), Carson-Tahoe (KCXP), South Palm Beach (KLNA) and Springfield (KSPI), and recently refreshed its Reno-Tahoe FBO. Solport brings the same standard to southern Arizona.
I'm the contact for Solport. My details are on this card; you can select and copy them.

Everything a flight needs, under one roof. Arrivals and check-in are inside the doors, the crew lounge and flight planning room sit beside this stand, and concierge can arrange cars and ground transport onto Genesis One. Out on the ramp we handle fuel, hangar space and ground services. Stellar looks after the aviation side of Solport, from the moment a jet lands to the moment it leaves.

financeadvisors.footer: Nothing here is an offer to sell securities or investment advice.
greet: Hi, I'm Paul. Come on in.
Matching retirees with the right wealth manager.
Questions about how capital moves in Genesis One? Ask away.

talk.t: Hi, I'm Paul Mazzapica, Co-Founder and President of FinanceAdvisors.com. We are a fintech company that matches high-net-worth retirees with wealth managers, servicing Fisher Investments, Edelman Financial Engines, Empower and more. What can I help you with?
o: How does capital move in Genesis One?

talk.t: You answer a short questionnaire about your situation, your goals and the state you live in, and we introduce you to licensed, independent wealth managers who fit. FinanceAdvisors.com does not give investment advice itself: the advisor you choose does, under their own licence and duties to you.
o: How does capital move in Genesis One?

talk.t: Here is the path money takes in the Giveback ecosystem: a corporate bank account, then the Altitude bridge onto the blockchain, then a Squads multisig treasury that needs several signers to move anything, then the Giveback protocol, and finally nonprofits verified by Giveback Ventures' own compliance team. Every step is recorded on chain, so anyone can follow it. $GBACK is the utility token that runs on those rails; Giveback Ventures is its largest holder, not its issuer, and it is never an investment.

Tokenizing a real-world asset means recording ownership or rights in it as tokens on a blockchain, with the legal documents behind them. For land like Genesis One that can make records transparent and transfers simpler. Any investment in a project like this is a securities matter, handled by licensed professionals, never by a token in a game.
o: How does capital move in Genesis One?

talk.t: Then speak with Riverside Management Group directly. Giveback Ventures and RMG have signed an agreement to work together, and RMG brings decades of merchant banking and capital markets experience; its affiliated broker-dealer, BCW Securities, is a FINRA member. Will Deitrick of RMG is at GBANK, on the east side of Compass Plaza. I can't take investments or give investment advice here.
Thanks for stopping by. My details are on this card if you want to talk about finding the right wealth manager. Nothing here is an offer to sell securities or investment advice.

jetfinders.name: JetFinders
jetfinders.tagline: The only jet contact you'll ever need.
jetfinders.blurb: One advisor for all your flying: on-demand charter, jet cards, fractional ownership, aircraft sales and management, hangars, aircraft tax and business solutions, and asset tokenization.
greet: The only jet contact you'll ever need.
Charter, jet cards, hangars. Ask me anything.
Thinking about a hangar home? Start here.

talk.t: I'm Jake with JetFinders. Welcome to JetFinders, the only jet contact you'll ever need: one advisor for all your flying, with access to around 3,500 aircraft in more than 170 countries. What can I help with?

On-demand charter, jet cards, fractional ownership, aircraft sales and management, business and specialty flights such as helicopter and medical, real estate and hangars, aircraft tax and business solutions, and asset tokenization.

JetFinders is the aviation partner for Genesis One: charters in and out of Solport, owners' aircraft at home on the Flight Line, and hangars and hangar homes with their own taxiway access. Captain Reyes flies with us; you'll find him out on the apron by Gate A2.

Asset tokenization records ownership of an aircraft, or rights in one, on a blockchain with the legal paperwork behind it. An advisor can walk you through how it works for a specific aircraft; anything that involves investing is handled by licensed professionals.
Start at jetfinders.com and request a quote, and an advisor will come back to you. The details are on this card.

freedomair.name: Freedom Air
freedomair.blurb: Private jet charter and aircraft management from Reno, Nevada, positioning aircraft right here at Solport.
greet: Need a jet positioned on the runway? Ask me.
Empty legs this week. Ask me what's open.

talk.t: I'm Joe, and this is Beth. Welcome to Freedom Air. We run private jet charter and aircraft management out of Reno, and we position aircraft right here at Solport. Where are you headed?
Challenger 300, Citation X, Citation XLS, CJ3+, Epic E1000 and a Pilatus PC-12, plus an Airbus EC130 helicopter for tours. West Coast, East Coast and the Caribbean.
Empty legs are one-way repositioning flights, offered when an aircraft has to fly that way anyway. Ask and we'll tell you what's open this week.
Call +1 775 447 9830 or email charter@freedomairservices.com, and tell them Genesis One sent you. The details are on this card.
